claim: Milestone 2A frozen INT8 post-training quantization workflow: PyTorch eager-mode static PTQ on the 23 nn.Linear islands of the unchanged PAVE Standard Transformer. The converted model is hybrid (INT8 Linear, FP32 everything else), not integer-only. Pilot results are non-scientific development checks (1 seed, 2 epochs, small subsets, validation data only) and carry no accuracy or robustness conclusion.

ptq.workflow: torch.ao.quantization eager-mode static PTQ (torch 2.5.1, fbgemm CPU backend); FX graph mode and PT2E fail on the unchanged model and are not used
ptq.qconfig: torch.ao.quantization.get_default_qconfig('fbgemm'): HistogramObserver (quint8, reduce_range) for activations, PerChannelMinMaxObserver (qint8) for weights
ptq.calibration_input: noise-free repeated 50-position sequences, rows in ascending row-ID order
fp32_remaining_operations: inter-island activations (each island quantizes its input and dequantizes its output)
Linear biases (kept in FP32 inside the packed parameters)
ptq.anomaly_scorer_note: the two anomaly_scorer linears are quantized although they do not feed the classification logits; they are counted separately from the classification path

serialization.logits_check: bitwise equal (torch.equal) on every evaluated row
serialization.identity_wrapper_check: island wrapper reproduces the FP32 logits with atol=0 before observers run
structure_checks: all islands are torch.ao.nn.quantized.Linear with qint8 per_channel_affine packed weights
no FakeQuantize, observer or float nn.Linear module remains
torch.profiler shows quantized::linear on a real forward pass

qat_feasibility.status: optional V5; bounded feasibility check only, never blocks V1-V4
qat_feasibility.training_noise: same Gaussian std 0.01 policy and derived_seed('shuffle'|'noise') streams as train_unit
qat_feasibility.inference_check: real INT8 inference on pilot validation rows with finite logits

campaign_qat.status: optional; specified here, not run in M2A
campaign_qat.noise_and_shuffle: same derived_seed('noise') and derived_seed('shuffle') streams as the base training

controls.FP32-FT: same k epochs, same learning rate, same data order and noise, no fake quantization
controls.FP32-FT->PTQ: FP32-FT checkpoint followed by the same PTQ workflow and calibration IDs

campaign_qat.attribution_rule: any QAT benefit is attributed only relative to FP32-FT->PTQ, never relative to V2, because QAT receives extra fine-tuning epochs
